 1.

From the record it transpires that in compliance of the direction of this Court notice was served upon the de-facto complainant/opposite party no. 2 herein at the behest of the State and the report to that effect is kept with the record.

2. None appears on behalf of the private opposite party no. 2.
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner as well as the State are present.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has drawn my attention to the First Information Report and submitted that the victim/de-facto complainant was well aware of the fact that the petitioner/accused was married with another woman.
5.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State has also drawn my attention to the statement recorded under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure wherefrom it is revealed that the Darshan Vidyasagar Jariwalla @ Darshan vs Jariwalla on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190808489/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. The instant revisional application has been filed in respect of quashing of the proceeding in connection with ACGR Case No. 612 of 2020 corresponding of Pragati Maidan Police Station Case No. 21 of 2024 dated 7th February, 2024 under Sections 376, 377 and 417 of the Indian Penal Code.

7. Having heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the parties as well as having gone through all the documents annexed with the revision application as well as the evidence collected at the instance of the investigating authority, I am inclined to grant interim stay of the proceeding for a limited period.
8. Let the proceeding in connection with ACGR Case No. 612 of 2020 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore, South 24 Parganas be stayed till 29th November, 2025 or until further order, whichever is earlier.
9.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore, South 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accordingly, CRAN 1 of 2025 stands disposed of.

11.

(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
